dataList.name: Dueling
dataList.desc:
When HP falls below 50%, uses a special skill to target 1 unit, then becomes immune to Stagger and Panic for the next 2 turns.
If Yi Sang has 'Dueling', Dongbaek nhận 1 [Enhancement].
If Yi Sang wins the duel, all allies nhận 3 [AttackDmgUp] vào lượt kế.
If Dongbaek wins the duel, Dongbaek fully hồi SP.

- When the unit with the earliest Deployment order has 3+ [Teaching], this unit does not nhận Shield for the rest of the Encounter

dataList.name: Tigermark Round Reload
dataList.desc:
Cuối Lượt: at 90% or less HP, or at the end of the 2nd turn, reload [BulletPropellant] and nhận a new pattern vào lượt kế
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger

dataList.name: Lei Heng [雷橫]
dataList.desc:
Cuối Lượt: at 80% or less HP, or at the end of the 4th turn, nhận a new pattern vào lượt kế
- Use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver'), repeat every 3rd turn. +10 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- At the start of that turn, nhận 25 [BattleSense]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger

dataList.name: Tiantui Star [天退星]
dataList.desc:
If this unit's HP dropped to 60% or below at Turn End, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') vào lượt kế for the second time this Encounter, nhận a new pattern vào lượt kế
- When that turn starts, nhận 1 [Irritation]
- When that turn starts, nhận 18 [BulletPropellantSpecial] and reload immediately
· If this unit spends all [BulletPropellantSpecial], convert the effect to [BulletPropellant] and summon 2 of "Stern Soldato of the Thumb" units vào lượt kế and have them supply this unit with [BulletPropellantSpecial]
- When Staggered, recover from Stagger

dataList.name: Lei Heng, The Pinky's Tiantui Star
dataList.desc:
Cuối Lượt: at 40% or less HP, or if this unit is set to use a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver') vào lượt kế for the third time this Encounter, nhận a new pattern vào lượt kế
- Replace the powerful attack 'Tanglecleaver' with 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'. +15 to Min & Max Speed for turns in which this unit uses this Skill
- Convert [BattleSense] to [RestoredBattleSense]
- Convert [Irritation] to [DerivativeHugeIrritation]
- If this unit is Staggered, recover from Stagger

dataList.name: Tiantui Star's Blade - Overheat
dataList.desc: If this unit used a powerful attack ('Tanglecleaver' or 'Savage Tigerslayer's Perfected Flurry of Blades'), nhận [Complacency] vào lượt kế equal to the number of times those skills were used (tối đa 5)
